title: Rippling:  #1 Workforce Management System  | Product Hunt
excerpt: HR, IT, and Finance data all on one platform, so AI can answer questions, automate work, and help teams get more done. Rippling empowers your business to save time, reduce costs, and enhance efficiency, so you can focus on growth.
